lcc_original: 那人說：『阿！這是我骨中之骨，我肉中之肉阿！這可以稱爲女人，因爲這是從男人身上取出來的。』
notes: Rule 3 applied: first 阿！treated as explicit rendering of implicit {WH06471} (pa'am = 'now/this time'); braces dropped since LCC uses an explicit exclamatory particle for this intensifier
Second sentence-final 阿！has no Hebrew correspondent and is left unannotated — it is a Chinese rhetorical device added by the LCC translator
WAH09001 (lamed prefix of לְזֹאת) co-attached to 這 forming 這<WAH09001><WH02063>; the lamed is absorbed into the topic-comment structure of LCC rather than being placed on the verb phrase

骨中/肉中 receive WAH04480+H6106/H1320 tags following UNV's pattern for the source-genitive arm; 之骨/之肉 receive the bare H6106/H1320 for the predicate arm — LCC's 之 replaces UNV's 的 with no change in SN assignment
身上 in 從男人身上 has no direct Hebrew correspondent (Hebrew is simply מֵאִישׁ); left unannotated
